## A fixed deck {#fixed-one}

This deck loads the same annotation plugin but leaves `pages` at its default.
Navigating past the last slide must do nothing: growing the deck is what the
blank pad is for and exactly wrong in a lecture deck.

## The last slide {#fixed-two}

There is nothing after this.
